name: srtti_mirror
description: Mirror of [S-RTTI](https://github.com/sandraros/S-RTTI) renamed to the z2ui5_ namespace

scripts.delete_unit_tests: find src -name '*testclasses.abap' -exec rm {} + && find src -type f -exec sed -i '/<WITH_UNIT_TESTS>X<\/WITH_UNIT_TESTS>/d' {} +
scripts.rename: abaplint abaplint_rename.json --rename && rm src/* && cp output/input/src/* src/
